title: Rice Paper Fake Bacon
description: If you are vegan or vegetarian, this fake bacon recipe using rice paper, liquid smoke, salty miso, and sweet maple syrup is a must-try.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Whisk sesame oil, soy sauce, maple syrup, miso, liquid smoke, paprika, and black pepper together in a shallow bowl.

Stack 2 pieces of rice paper and soak them in a bowl of cold water until slightly soft and pliable, about 30 seconds. Cut the hydrated rice paper into strips using a pizza cutter. Dip each strip in the soy mixture and place on a sheet of parchment paper. Carefully lay the parchment paper directly on the oven rack.
Bake in the preheated oven until strips are dry, 6 to 8 minutes.

video.description: Whether you're baking it or airfrying it, believe it or not, this fake bacon recipe actually works. In this video, Annie tests out a clever method for making imitation bacon that comes out looking very close to the real thing. This recipe is fully vegetarian and vegan, using only rice paper, sesame oil, soy sauce, and a few other seasonings. After soaking the rice paper strips, Annie tries cooking the fake bacon two ways - one in the air fryer, and the other baked in an oven. The oven method worked out well, yielding crispy and flavorful bacon that’s perfect when cooking for a crowd. See how the air fryer method worked out.
